verdict.rationale: 1Password ships automation surfaces such as service accounts, the op CLI, Connect, and SDKs, so asking about automation versioning is a fair question. However, nothing in the pack shows a way to version, review, or roll back user automations. Events API URL-path versioning is API version management, not user automation history, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
